title: Targeting "undruggable" cancer proteins: pharmacological challenges and emerging strategies.
authors: Coelho-Silva, Juan Luiz; Parducci, Natalia Sudan; Carvalho, Maria Fernanda Lopes; Vahedian, Vahid; Lima, Keli; de Almeida, Bruna Oliveira; Machado-Neto, Joao Agostinho
one_liner_zh: 综述靶向‘不可成药’癌症蛋白（含转录因子）的六类策略，提及AI但非聚焦蛋白-DNA互作建模，仅部分相关。
abstract: Precision oncology has revolutionized cancer biology, yet a critical disconnect persists: many pivotal oncogenic drivers, such as MYC, KRAS, and transcription factors, remain 'undruggable' by conventional small molecules due to a lack of traditional ligand-binding pockets. Overcoming this barrier is an urgent clinical necessity. This review maps and analyzes six key innovative strategies that are redefining druggability: (I) targeted protein degradation [TPD; proteolysis-targeting chimeras (PROTACs) and molecular glues], which catalytically eliminates proteins via the ubiquitin-proteasome system; (II) protein-protein interaction (PPI) inhibitors, which block critical oncogenic interfaces; (III) nucleic acid-based therapies [small interfering RNA (siRNA), antisense oligonucleotides (ASOs), clustered regularly interspaced short palindromic repeats (CRISPR)/CRISPR-associated protein 9 (Cas9)], which modulate targets at the RNA or DNA level; (IV) covalent inhibitors, which form irreversible bonds with specific residues; (V) allosteric modulation, which exploits hidden or cryptic binding pockets; and (VI) artificial intelligence (AI), which accelerates discovery by predicting structures and designing novel molecules. For each modality, we discuss mechanistic principles, historical development, and clinical translation, highlighting success stories and persistent challenges. Finally, we synthesize these approaches into an integrated perspective, arguing that their future convergence, for example, using AI to design next-generation degraders or combining PPI inhibitors with immunotherapies, will be essential to overcome the limitations of any single approach and reshape the standard of care. This review argues that the paradigm of undruggability is being dismantled by a shift from simple occupancy-based inhibition to event-driven degradation, state-specific modulation, and root-cause genetic correction.
abstract_zh: 精准肿瘤学已彻底改变了癌症生物学，然而一个关键断层依然存在：许多关键的致癌驱动因子，如MYC、KRAS和转录因子，由于缺乏传统的配体结合口袋，仍无法被常规小分子药物“靶向”。克服这一障碍是迫切的临床需求。本综述梳理并分析了六种正在重新定义可成药性的关键创新策略：（I）靶向蛋白降解 [TPD；蛋白水解靶向嵌合体 (PROTACs) 和分子胶 (molecular glues)]，通过泛素-蛋白酶体系统催化性消除蛋白质；（II）蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用 (PPI) 抑制剂，阻断关键的致癌相互作用界面；（III）基于核酸的疗法 [小干扰RNA (siRNA)、反义寡核苷酸 (ASOs)、成簇规律间隔短回文重复序列 (CRISPR)/CRISPR相关蛋白9 (Cas9)]，在RNA或DNA水平调节靶点；（IV）共价抑制剂，与特定残基形成不可逆键；（V）变构调节，利用隐藏或隐蔽的结合口袋；（VI）人工智能 (AI)，通过预测结构和设计新型分子加速发现。对于每种模式，我们讨论了其机制原理、历史发展和临床转化，并强调了成功案例和持续存在的挑战。最后，我们将这些方法综合为一个整合视角，认为它们未来的融合，例如利用AI设计下一代降解剂或将PPI抑制剂与免疫疗法结合，将是克服任何单一方法局限性并重塑标准治疗的关键。本综述认为，“不可成药”范式正被从简单的占据驱动抑制向事件驱动降解、状态特异性调节和根源性基因纠正的转变所瓦解。
